gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-amiko: Amiko is a modern sans-serif whose lowercase stands tall and whose terminals point outward like a pair of tongs. Metamorphous leads with commanding strokes that thicken and thin in small, gentle steps.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla reads approachable and contemporary, its sans-serif s curves wide and barely curled in at the ends. Metamorphous adds command, its strokes swelling mildly like a worn felt marker.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anek-devanagari: Distinctly open letter mouths make the body read modern and plain, under heading lines drawn with a barely tilted calligraphy nib. Anek Devanagari, a sans, handles the steady reading, while Metamorphous handles the commanding, distinctive announcing.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Hairlines that never turn spindly give Metamorphous its commanding, distinctive presence, with room around every letter. Anek Gurmukhi, a sans-serif with big open counters, feels generous and easygoing beside that firm heading.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada is a sans-serif with a high x-height, squared off like woodblock type. Metamorphous, meanwhile, does the commanding work, tightening slightly at curve tops where the body simply reads.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin is a sans whose lowercase nearly reaches the capitals. Letters stay held open, never curled shut, so the body can sit at a modest size while Metamorphous keeps its commanding, softly swelling strokes.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anek-malayalam: Clean and contemporary, Anek Malayalam is a sans-serif with little gap between its lowercase and caps. And its curve tips stop short of touching, so paragraphs of text would move along easily beneath Metamorphous.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia reads clean and contemporary, a sans-serif whose rounds stay unsealed like an unlatched hook and whose capitals barely rise. Metamorphous earns its keep big and short, its strokes stepping softly.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anek-tamil: Round, friendly bowls meet a commanding heading. Anek Tamil is a modern sans with big round lowercase bowls, and Metamorphous shifts its thickness in a way you feel more than see.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anek-telugu: Metamorphous thins slightly where curves meet stems, a commanding, distinctive touch that sets the heading apart from the text. Anek Telugu, plain sans, reads approachably, wide tall bowls setting the rhythm.
